'''Zoochberry cream''' was a type of [[Cream/Legends|cream]] that contained [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]] and was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Glove" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', which includes the meeting of the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> zoochberry cream was served at a meeting of the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], alongside [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]]. The Committee had declared the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[mutant]] [[Trioculus]] to be their new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], and while receiving suggestions from the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] for a new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base, Trioculus became enraged at the poor quality of their ideas and slammed his fist on the table, knocking a serving flask of zoochberry cream to the floor.<ref name="Glove" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoochberry cream appeared in ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', a [[1992]] novel by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Glove" />
